controls.name: registry-keeps-case
controls.find: pub open spec fn registry_text(name: Seq<int>) -> Seq<int> { Seq::new(name.len(), |i: int| up(name[i])) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn registry_text(name: Seq<int>) -> Seq<int> { name }
controls.classification: provider: the registry read answers the stored (lower-case) name, as SQLite or an EXACT collation would (the bug-plt-115 repair direction: compare case-insensitively)

controls.name: verify-counts-distinct-rows
controls.classification: decision: verify_sync compares ^NKG with the distinct (s,p,o) rows (the bug-plt-116 repair direction)

controls.name: nkg-per-graph
controls.classification: effect: BuildNKG counts one edge per row (a graph dimension in ^NKG)

controls.name: heal-rereads
controls.find: else { (SyncReport { in_sync: true, healed: true, ..r }, sync_ns(ns), sync_eng(ns, eng)) }
controls.replace: else { (SyncReport { healed: true, ..verify(sync_ns(ns), sync_eng(ns, eng)) }, sync_ns(ns), sync_eng(ns, eng)) }
controls.classification: effect: heal=True reports what a check after the sync reads, not a stamped in_sync

controls.name: status-pending-reads-nkg
controls.find: bfs_path: if kgp { Path::ObjectScript } else { Path::None }, pending: eng.dirty,
controls.replace: bfs_path: if kgp { Path::ObjectScript } else { Path::None }, pending: eng.dirty || (kgp && !ns.nkg_dict),
controls.classification: decision: the report's sync line also says 'needs sync' when edges exist and ^NKG is not built

controls.name: setup-inits-skeleton
controls.find: setup(Ns { rows: Seq::empty(), node_graphs: Seq::empty(), nkg_skeleton: false,
controls.replace: setup(Ns { rows: Seq::empty(), node_graphs: Seq::empty(), nkg_skeleton: true,
controls.classification: effect: setup of an empty namespace creates the ^NKG skeleton, so the first edges are interned

controls.name: multihop-needs-nkg
controls.find: pub open spec fn ready_for_multihop_bfs(s: Status) -> bool { ready_for_bfs(s) && s.bfs_path != Path::None }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn ready_for_multihop_bfs(s: Status) -> bool { ready_for_bfs(s) && s.nkg_populated }
controls.classification: decision: multi-hop readiness requires ^NKG (the ADMIN_GUIDE 'algorithms need it' reading)

controls.name: sync-sets-markers
controls.find: Ns { nkg_skeleton: true, nkg_dict: ns.rows.len() > 0, nkg_triples: triples_of(ns.rows),
controls.replace: Ns { marker_kg: true, marker_nkg: true, nkg_skeleton: true, nkg_dict: ns.rows.len() > 0, nkg_triples: triples_of(ns.rows),
controls.classification: effect: sync() records the kg_built/nkg_built markers (the bug-plt-117 repair direction)

controls.name: setup-marks-empty
controls.classification: guard: bootstrap_kg_global sets the markers with no rows to build from

controls.name: engine-cache-unchanged
controls.find: Eng { dirty: false, caps: Some(Caps { kg_built: true, ..c }) }
controls.classification: effect: _sync_kg does not set the calling engine's capabilities.kg_built

controls.name: bulk-leaves-flag
controls.find: pub open spec fn bulk_eng(eng: Eng) -> Eng { Eng { dirty: true, ..eng } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn bulk_eng(eng: Eng) -> Eng { eng }
controls.classification: effect: bulk_load_session in a caller transaction leaves _nkg_dirty alone

controls.name: delete-keeps-nkg
controls.find: Ns { rows: keep, nkg_skeleton: false, nkg_dict: false, nkg_triples: |t: (int, int, int)| false, nkg_count: 0, ..ns }
controls.classification: effect: the Eraser leaves ^NKG in place

controls.name: drop-keeps-index
controls.find: pub open spec fn bm25_drop(ns: Ns, name: int) -> Ns { Ns { bm25: ns.bm25.remove(name), ..ns } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn bm25_drop(ns: Ns, name: int) -> Ns { ns }
controls.classification: effect: bm25_drop leaves the name in BM25Index.List

controls.name: stats-every-graph
controls.find: pub open spec fn stats_nodes(ns: Ns) -> nat { count_in(ns.node_graphs, 0) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn stats_nodes(ns: Ns) -> nat { ns.node_graphs.len() }
controls.classification: decision: /stats counts every graph (the pre-4.6.0 R249 behavior)

controls.name: viz-none-distinct
controls.classification: decision: an unlabeled endpoint gets an id no label has (the bug-plt-118 repair direction)
